name: zerofailed-tools
description: Tools for working with the ZeroFailed automation framework — includes author-zerofailed-extension for scaffolding and extending ZeroFailed extension modules, a reference skill for each ZeroFailed build/deploy extension (DevOps.Common, Build.Common/DotNet/PowerShell/Python/GitHub/Containers, Deploy.Common/Azure/PowerBI/Fabric) covering their properties, tasks and dependency chains, cicd-gha for wiring up the companion GitHub Actions reusable workflows, upgrade-zerofailed for upgrading a repo to the latest ZeroFailed (entry-point bootstrap, per-process lock files, Frozen mode in CI), plus apply-github-repo-settings for applying the standard GitHub repository settings and default-branch ruleset (required CI build check, optional PR approval)
